hints.title: Positive Differential Accumulation
hints.text: Every time target[i] exceeds target[i - 1], the difference represents new operations that had to be initiated at or before index i.

hints.title: Adjacent Differences
hints.text: Add target[0] to the answer, then add max(0, target[i] - target[i - 1]) for all i > 0.

hints.title: Single Pass Computation
hints.text: Iterate from index 1 to n - 1 accumulating positive step increases.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Segment tree simulation or interval reduction takes O(n log n) or O(n^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects realizing that positive differences between adjacent elements sum to the minimal operations.
